json_data.Test Description: Validates GPIO GP0 register default values and masked write/read behavior across a predefined list of GPIO registers. For each register address in the test list, the test skips entries marked unreadable or to be skipped, reads the default value and compares against the expected default. Then for multiple data patterns, it writes masked values to writable registers and reads back using read masks, validating against a computed expectation. Test passes if all comparisons match; otherwise it fails. The register addresses are defined by unresolved register macros MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 through MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_27 and associated default/mask macros.
json_data.Meta Test Description:
Objective: Verify default reset values and masked write/read functionality of a set of GPIO GP0 registers.
Initialization: def_fail_cnt = 0; wr_fail_cnt = 0. Arrays provided by test_define.c: addr_array[], default_value_array[], read_mask_array[], write_mask_array[], skip_array[], skip_rst_array[].
Default value check (chk_rst_val): For i in [0..CNT-1]: addr = addr_array[i]; if (skip_rst_array[i] == 1) continue; if (read_mask_array[i] == 0x00000000) continue; data_rd = read_reg(addr); data = (data_rd & 0xfffffffe); if (data == default_value_array[i]) PASS else { def_fail_cnt++; printf failure with addr, expected default_value_array[i], data, data_rd }.
Write/Read check (chk_rd_wr): For each pattern in {0xffffffff, 0xaaaaaaaa, 0x55555555, 0xf5f5f5f5, 0xA5A5A5A5, 0xffff0000}: data_wr = pattern; Write phase: for i in [0..CNT-1]: addr = addr_array[i]; if (skip_array[i] == 1) continue; if (write_mask_array[i] == 0x00000000) continue; write_reg(addr, (data_wr & write_mask_array[i])); Read/validate phase: for i in [0..CNT-1]: addr = addr_array[i]; if (skip_array[i] == 1) continue; if (write_mask_array[i] == 0x00000000) continue; if (read_mask_array[i] == 0x00000000) continue; data_rd = (read_reg(addr) & read_mask_array[i]); wr_n = (write_mask_array[i] ^ 0xffffffff); exp_val = ((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])); if (data_rd == exp_val) PASS else { wr_fail_cnt++; printf mismatch with addr, exp_val, data_rd }.
Termination: if (def_fail_cnt > 0 || wr_fail_cnt > 0) finish(1) else finish(0).
Other: soft_reset_chk() exists but is compiled out (#ifdef 0); it would read/write SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS using SOFT_RST_REG_DATA and wait_on().
json_data.Remarks: Known constraint: when reading default values, DIN becomes 1 automatically unless forced low; forcing zero to DIN may cause mode select to change high, leading to read value not matching expected.
json_data.Test Steps / Procedure:
1. Initialize failure counters and load test arrays of register addresses, default values, read masks, write masks, and skip controls.
2. For each register address in the list, if marked to skip reset check or unreadable, skip; otherwise read the register and compare the masked value against the expected default value.
3. For each of the configured data patterns, write masked values to each writable and non-skipped register address.
4. Read back each written register using the read mask and compute the expected value combining the pattern with write/read masks and preserved default bits; compare the read value to the expected value and record failures on mismatch.
5. Declare test PASS if no mismatches were detected across all checks; otherwise declare FAIL.
json_data.Meta Test Steps / Procedure:
test_case(): call chk_rst_val(); call chk_rd_wr(); if (def_fail_cnt > 0 || wr_fail_cnt > 0) finish(1); else finish(0).
chk_rst_val(): for (i=0; i<CNT; i++): addr = addr_array[i]; if (skip_rst_array[i] == 1) continue; if (read_mask_array[i] == 0x00000000) continue; data_rd = read_reg(addr); data = (data_rd & 0xfffffffe); if (data == default_value_array[i]) PASS else { def_fail_cnt++; printf failure }.
chk_rd_wr(): patterns = {0xffffffff,0xaaaaaaaa,0x55555555,0xf5f5f5f5,0xA5A5A5A5,0xffff0000}; for each data_wr in patterns: Write phase: for (i=0; i<CNT; i++): addr = addr_array[i]; if (skip_array[i] == 1) continue; if (write_mask_array[i] == 0x00000000) continue; write_reg(addr, (data_wr & write_mask_array[i])). Read/validate phase: for (i=0; i<CNT; i++): addr = addr_array[i]; if (skip_array[i] == 1) continue; if (write_mask_array[i] == 0x00000000) continue; if (read_mask_array[i] == 0x00000000) continue; data_rd = (read_reg(addr) & read_mask_array[i]); wr_n = (write_mask_array[i] ^ 0xffffffff); exp_val = ((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])); if (data_rd == exp_val) PASS else { wr_fail_cnt++; printf mismatch }.
soft_reset_chk() [compiled out]: read_reg(SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS); write_reg(SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS, SOFT_RST_REG_DATA); wait_on(1000); write_reg(SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS, default_value); wait_on(1000).
json_data.Validation / Acceptance Criteria: Pass if, for every tested register address, the masked default read matches the expected default value and every masked write/read comparison across all data patterns matches the computed expected value; otherwise fail.
json_data.Meta Validation / Acceptance Criteria: Default check: For each i, PASS when ((read_reg(addr_array[i]) & 0xfffffffe) == default_value_array[i]); else increment def_fail_cnt and log. Write/read check: For each pattern and each i with write_mask_array[i] != 0 and read_mask_array[i] != 0 and not skipped, after write_reg(addr_array[i], (pattern & write_mask_array[i])), read back data_rd = (read_reg(addr_array[i]) & read_mask_array[i]); compute wr_n = (write_mask_array[i] ^ 0xffffffff); exp_val = ((pattern & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])); PASS if (data_rd == exp_val); else increment wr_fail_cnt and log. Final result: finish(0) if def_fail_cnt == 0 and wr_fail_cnt == 0; otherwise finish(1).
